name: library
description: Read, edit, and publish an owner-authenticated Personal Library.

interface.shortDescription: Read, edit, and publish your Personal Library
interface.longDescription: Library connects Codex to an owner-authenticated collection of Daily, Digest, and Research editions. It can find and read existing issues, revise complete issue HTML, preserve public references and cover metadata, upload generated cover or illustration assets, and publish a new scheduled edition. The Library Site remains the visual reading and direct-editing surface; the remote MCP handles page-independent work against the same D1 and R2 canonical data.
capabilities: Scheduled Daily, Digest, and Research publication
